Shadowheart.title: Shadowheart
Shadowheart.summary: Shadowheart (born Jenevelle Hallowleaf) is an Origin character and a recruitable companion who can be romanced by characters of any gender.  She is a high half-elf and a Trickery Domain Cleric with the Acolyte background.

Lae'zel.title: Lae'zel
Lae'zel.summary: Lae'zel of Crèche K'liir is an Origin Character and a recruitable Companion who can be romanced by characters of any gender.  She is a Githyanki Fighter with the Soldier background.

Astarion.title: Astarion
Astarion.summary: Astarion Ancunín is an Origin character and recruitable companion who can be romanced by characters of any gender.  He is a high elven rogue with the Charlatan background.

Gale.title: Gale
Gale.summary: Gale Dekarios is an Origin Character and recruitable Companion who can be romanced by characters of any gender.  He is a human wizard with the Sage background.

Wyll.title: Wyll
Wyll.summary: Wyll Ravengard is an Origin Character and a recruitable Companion who can be romanced by characters of any gender.  He is a Human and a Fiend Warlock with the Folk Hero background.

Karlach.title: Karlach
Karlach.summary: Karlach Cliffgate is an Origin Character and a recruitable Companion who can be romanced by characters of any gender.  She is a Zariel Tiefling and a Barbarian with the Outlander background.
